comment: The missed comparison was B versus A. I overvalued A’s three early LayerNorms and presumed its small initial logits would beat B’s low-rate Adagrad. A’s two unnormalized terminal GELU blocks plausibly attenuate useful features and SGD gradients; B’s shallower adaptive network avoids that particular bottleneck. K1059/K1061 warned about SGD tail placement, while K1012 explicitly rejects initialization-based ordering at low progress. Lab checks found terminal LN better in 12/12 matched-shape, equal-LN SGD contrasts across eight spiral sets, but these test placement, not B versus A. Exact comparable cross-optimizer pairs numbered zero in both history and lab. Thus the mechanism remains plausible, not established; no tested general rule warrants promotion.
